title: Broadridge and Payward Services collaborate to give xStocks holders a voice in corporate governance
message_html: Broadridge and Payward Services collaborate to give xStocks holders a voice in corporate governance ...
snippet: Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc., (NYSE: BR), a global Fintech leader, today announced Broadridge’s unified governance platform will support shareholder communications and proxy voting for eligible holders of xStocks, the industry-leading tokenized equities framework developed by Payward Service

title: S&P gives BlackRock tokenized reserve fund top stability rating
message_html: S&P gives BlackRock tokenized reserve fund top stability rating ...
snippet: The rating recognizes the fund’s ability to maintain a stable net asset value, while S&P separately reaffirmed USDT among the lowest-rated stablecoins under its existing assessment framework.
